newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB 1996 dealing profits down.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB 1996 dealing profits down.

text.p: Dealing profits at Lloyd's TSB Group Plc fell in 1996 by 45 percent to 96 million stg before expenses from 175 million in 1995.
Lloyds said its foreign exchange trading income, down at 113 million stg from 122 million stg in 1995, held up well despite less favourable trading conditions.
Income from securities and other trading, however, dropped sharply by 70 million stg in 1996 to post a loss of 17 million stg from 53 million profit stg in 1995.

Lloyds said this included investment gains on marking-to-market the general insurance portfolio, which were 21 million stg lower than in 1995 as the equity and gilt markets strengthened less than the previous year.
Lloyd's TSB on Friday reported a 52 percent jump in 1996 pre-tax profits to 2.505 billion pounds ($4.09 billion).
